gloss: to rush over to; to run up to

forms.negative: {駆|か}け{寄|よ}りませんでした

definitions.gloss: to rush over to; to run up to
definitions.explanation: To run toward someone or something, usually out of urgency, excitement, or concern. Conveys quick movement toward a specific person or place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}け{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: The child ran over to their mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}け{寄|よ}って⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I rushed over to the person who had collapsed and called out to them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尻尾|しっぽ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{駆|か}け{寄|よ}ってきた。
examples.english: When I arrived at my grandparents' house after a long time, the dog came running over wagging its tail.

notes:
An intransitive godan verb composed of ⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run/dash) + ⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧ (to approach). The ～てくる form ({駆|か}け{寄|よ}ってくる) emphasizes someone running toward the speaker.

ASPECT (ている):
Not commonly used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form since it describes a quick, punctual action.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}け{寄|よ}る (rush over to someone/something)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}け{寄|よ}る (rush to someone's side)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駆|か}け{寄|よ}ってくる (come running over)
- {駆|か}け{寄|よ}って⟦{抱|だ}きつく→抱きつく：12805_dakitsuku⟧ (rush over and hug)
- {駆|か}け{寄|よ}って⟦{声|こえ}をかける→声をかける：30589_koewokakeru⟧ (rush over and call out)
